idea-plugin.name: Chimeric Mod Status
idea-plugin.description:
Shows each Minecraft mod's current version directly in the Project View, next to the mod's folder name, in the same muted style the IDE uses for labels like "library root".

Mods whose CHANGELOG.md has entries under ### Unreleased changes are marked with an amber dot, both beside the version and as a badge on the folder icon, so it is obvious at a glance which mods have work that has not been released yet.

Built for the chimeric-mods monorepo: a folder is treated as a mod when its gradle.properties declares both mod_id and mod_version.
